scope: One four-branch target-only search round; not the full experiment book
last_batch_rule: fixed 2048 generation cap; full reward groups; uniform loss-token subset only at phase boundary
target_descriptor: Four-color Manufactoria transduction: replace every non-overlapping RB with YG in the input, then prepend RBYGRB. All valid inputs must terminate and have exactly the required output tape.
explicit_pilot_differences: Four temporary branches are search actions in one trajectory, not four independent training replications
Distinct fixed branch-labelled streams within one training seed42; no independent training-repeat or seed scan
All temporary branches train only on the unchanged complete target verifier
No Challenger proposal generation or update; same target-conditioned endpoint selector
No new eligibility audit, checkpoint hash scan or official-test access
scope_rule: observed non-decrease in both scope metrics; no population guarantee
policy_identity_rule: zero-update fresh branches have exact zero gain against unchanged direct; retain raw estimates separately
budget_note: Matches the primary method's four-branch loss-token allocation, not all end-to-end compute; generation, selection, verification and recovery cost remain separate
update_note: step after >=threshold tokens at complete-group boundary; fewer steps than nominal token units
